instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep the consent of a person who asked for one email if a course becomes available, without sending anything", and give it email; consent; course.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:save-interest-in-an-email-update and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give email, consent (true only when the person agreed in the words of course.consent_text) and course ({ id, public_origin as an https site root, consent_text, consent_version, capture_only: true }) and source (optional).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: email-course-interest (records:read, records:write).
